# Korea Economic Narrative Intelligence

This site publishes a read-only, machine-readable projection of economic and industrial narrative data derived from the print editions of Maeil Business Newspaper and Korea Economic Daily.

Coverage:
- Publishers: 매일경제, 한국경제
- Print scope: A1-A10
- Collection period: 2026-04-01 ~ 2026-10-09
- Full article text is not stored or redistributed.
- Article summaries are independently rewritten factual summaries.
- Theme/Candidate counts describe observed media coverage; they are not investment scores or importance rankings.

Primary resources:
- Latest text: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/latest.txt
- Latest compact JSON: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/latest.json
- Themes: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/themes.json
- Emerging Candidate signals: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/candidates.json
- Narrative changes: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/narrative.json
- All verified article metadata and factual summaries in the collection period: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/articles.json
- Theme weekly timeline: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/theme_timeline.json
- Events: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/events.json
- Event-Theme relations: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/event_theme.json
- Weekly analysis: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/weekly_analysis.json
- Macro definitions and linkage policy: https://youndongkim.github.io/newspaper-ai-public/ai/macro.json
- Interactive dashboard: private / authentication required
